issues.description: The problem statement and solution specify the Farm method as feedAllAnimals(), but the template's Main.java (commented example) calls farm.feed(). This identifier mismatch (feed vs. feedAllAnimals) can confuse students and leads to a compilation error if they uncomment the example code in the template.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the identifier consistent across artifacts. Either change the commented example in src/de/tum/cit/ase/Main.java (template) to call farm.feedAllAnimals(), or implement a feed() convenience method in Farm that delegates to feedAllAnimals(). Prefer updating the template Main to use feedAllAnimals() so it matches the problem statement and solution.
